description: This file implements WebSocket streaming for remote command execution in Kubernetes, including channel creation, WebSocket connection setup, and protocol negotiation.

classes.name: connectionContext
classes.description: Holds WebSocket connection and streams for remote command execution.

methods.name: createChannels
methods.description: Creates standard WebSocket channels for stdin, stdout, stderr, error, and resize.

methods.name: readChannel
methods.description: Returns a read or ignore channel based on the boolean parameter.

methods.name: writeChannel
methods.description: Returns a write or ignore channel based on the boolean parameter.

methods.name: createWebSocketStreams
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection, negotiates protocol, and sets up streams for remote command execution.
